podcast.title: Death in 2009
podcast.body: Jim Carroll passed away in 2009 due to a heart attack. At the time, he was also suffering from pneumonia and hepatitis C. It is reported that he died while working at his desk. "Jim himself died in 2009 of a heart attack. He'd also been suffering from pneumonia and hepatitis C. The word is that he died while working at his desk."
